decisionsTitle: The bib's header: a long title fits beside the distance badge and never covers the date
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13**, on a printed number of the 21 November race: «când bifez distanța pe număr am overlap». With «Distanța pe număr» on, the race's long title — «CROSUL ANIVERSAR BRAȘOV RUNNERS – EDIȚIA A II-A 2026» — took two lines, and its second line («…A 2026») was printed on the date line («Sâmbătă, 21 nov 2026»); the title was also broken inside «A II-A», after the hyphen.

**What was wrong.** Amends §750 (the header's layout; the badge itself is unchanged). The sheet (`bibs-pdf.ts`) handed pdfkit the title with a width and `lineBreak: false`, which pdfkit ignores once it has a width: it wrapped the title at its own leading and after the hyphen, at a fixed `titleTop`, and the date was drawn at a fixed `dateTop` 19 points lower whatever the title had become. The badge took 56 points off a column that was already narrow beside the lockup (327 points), which is what pushed the title onto a second line. The picture (`bib-image.tsx`) cut the same title with «…» on one line, so the preview the club checks before printing did not even show the fault — the two renderers disagreed.

**Decision.** One layout for the header, `bibHeaderLayout` in `bib-geometry.ts`, and both renderers draw exactly its lines; neither wraps anything any more (the small print's rule, §317, applied to the header).

- **The column**: from the lockup's right plus the inset (the card's inset without the lockup) to the card's right inset less the badge and its 10-point gap. Every line is right-aligned on it and measured no wider than it.
- **The title** is split at spaces only. A hyphenated word («II-A», «Cros-Country») is one word, and a dash standing alone between words stays at the end of the line before it. A non-breaking hyphen (U+2011) was the other way and is refused: Roboto, the bib's font, has no glyph for it and would print a box (a test holds this). From 13 points down to **9 points**, by half a point, the first size at which the title fits on one line or on two — two balanced, the break that makes the longer line shortest — and the whole block, the date included, fits the band with 4 points to spare at its top and foot. **Only past the minimum** (about 130 characters of capitals beside the lockup and the badge) is anything left out: the first line takes as many whole words as fit, the second as many as fit with «…» after them. The event's stored title is never changed.
- **The date** goes under the title's real height plus the 3.77 points a one-line title always left above it; alone, where it always was. A date wider than the column is cut with «…».
- **A title that fits on one line at 13 points prints exactly where it did**, on the sheet and in the picture (Satori's own line for Roboto is the one pdfkit uses, so the picture's lines carry an explicit line height that changes no pixel).
- **The badge** is centred on the band (it sat 3 points high), or — on the members' band, where their label sits under it — centred on the band above the label's tag, so it never touches the label.
- **Every header variant**: the race's band, the members' header «Același fundal ca restul numerelor — doar antet propriu» (there the column also stops above the label's line, so a long title is set a little smaller), and a member's whole card. A header picture still replaces the band whole and draws no words or badge; the §750 warning that it hides the event's name stays as it was.
- **The widths** come from Roboto Bold's advance widths and the pairs it kerns apart, read out of the font file and kept as a table beside the layout (`bib-header.ts`, the small print's method, §317); the date uses the small print's Regular table. The measure is never narrower than pdfkit or Satori sets a line, so a line laid out to fit cannot reach the badge or the lockup.
- **No stale picture.** The drawing changed while the designs did not, so the pictures' addresses would not have changed (§748): `BIB_DRAWING_VERSION` (now 2) enters the bibs page's stamp and the desk's SQL stamp, and every bib picture is drawn afresh once. A future change to how the same design draws raises it again.

**Refused.** A non-breaking hyphen in the drawn text (no glyph in the font); letting either renderer wrap or cut the header by itself; a fixed date offset under a title of any height; shrinking the title before trying two lines at the full size; a third line.

**Not changed.** The badge's size, words and colours, the lockup, the members' label, the number, the name, the small print and the profile strip; the stored design; no migration.
changelogLine: - **A long race title no longer covers the date on the bib** — with «Distanța pe număr» on, the title takes up to two lines beside the badge, smaller only when it must, never broken inside a word such as «II-A», with the date under it, on the printed sheet and the picture alike; every bib picture is redrawn once. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a race title too long for one line beside the lockup and the distance badge, the bib's header draws it in at most two lines, right of the lockup and at least 10 points short of the badge, on the PDF sheet, the picture, the desk's picture and the editor's preview alike, on the race's band, the members' band and a member's card. The title is split at spaces only: a hyphenated word such as «II-A» stays whole and a lone dash never starts a line (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The date is drawn under the title's real height and never under any of its lines, and on the members' band no line reaches the members' label; a title that fits on one line at 13 points prints where it always did. The title shrinks by half points down to 9 before anything is cut, and only then does its second line end with «…»; the stored title never changes (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The distance badge is centred on the band, or on the band above the members' label while one is drawn under it, and never overlaps any text. Every bib picture's address, on the bibs page and at the desk, carries the drawing's version, so a picture drawn before a change of the drawing is never served from the browser's cache after it (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the bib's header no longer overlaps
